subject: Intermittent 5xx and timeouts on AurumLite3b — mitigation & RCA
messages:

Cc: support@brightbridge.ai

Subject: Heavy 5xxs & timeouts from AurumLite3b (production)

Hi Karthik,

We started seeing elevated 5xx responses and timeouts on our production traffic using AurumLite3b around 08:55 PT. Rough pattern: 5xx rate spiked to ~18% for about 20 minutes and then degraded back down, but we had several customer-facing failures and queued retries. Sample request IDs attached.

Can you confirm whether this is a model-specific issue or something in the runtime? We are on the hosted Redwood API (region us-west-2), model pinned to aurumlite3b:v1.2.

Impact: user-facing errors in our chat flow (approx 2.4k requests failed). Our SREs are collecting traces/reqids; sending them over now. Please advise next steps and ETA.

Thanks,

Date: Mon, 30 Jul 2028 09:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Heavy 5xxs & timeouts from AurumLite3b (production)

Karthik / team — initial findings from infra: we saw a sharp increase in kernel-level OOM/retries on a subset of AurumLite3b hosts in us-west-2 between 08:50–09:15 PT. Observed characteristics:
- CPU utilization on those pods spiked and RPC latencies went high.
- Autoscaler placed additional hosts but there was an onboarding lag; some requests timed out waiting for warm KV caches.
- No network partition indicated.

Mitigations we applied:
1) Scaled the AurumLite3b host pool + evicted a small set of noisy batches.
2) Temporarily increased request timeouts for that model route to reduce client-side failure amplification.
3) Enabled a local fallback to aurumlite3b-quant (lower precision variant) for customers on our tier that allow fallbacks; BrightBridge was not configured with fallback, so we kept you in the primary path while we stabilized.

Next steps: we will continue to scan logs for correlated GC/driver errors and prepare a post-incident RCA. I recommend a short follow-up call once we have a draft RCA.

— Ben Carter
On-call Infra Lead, Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 31 Jul 2028 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: AurumLite3b incident — draft RCA and next steps

Hi Minh — attached is our RCA draft (PDF) and a short ops timeline. TL;DR: a combination of a spike in large-context requests and an imperfect cache-warmup path for newly added hosts caused transient KV cache misses and elevated kernel retries; that manifested as increased per-request latency and 5xxs.

Key findings:
- Root cause: onboarding delay for additional hosts triggered KV cache cold-starts; large-context requests exacerbated memory pressure on a host subset.
- Contributing factor: autoscaler thresholds were tuned conservatively to avoid over-provisioning; this increased the time window where capacity lagged demand.

Remediations and commitments:
- Short term (already applied): emergency scale + temporary fallback enable for affected customers; raised default model route timeouts for aurumlite3b.
- Medium term (2–3 weeks): adjust autoscaler cooldowns, add proactive pre-warming for KV caches when scale events are predicted, and add a per-tenant fallback flag in the Console so customers can opt-in to quant/fast-fallbacks.
- Long term (Q4): model variant health scoring and route-level graceful degradation policies.

Attachments: aurumlite3b-rca-draft.pdf

We can schedule a 30-minute walkthrough for stakeholders; proposed times tomorrow at 09:00 or 14:00 PT.

Thanks,
Soojin Lee
Principal Product Manager, Reliability
Redwood Inference
